content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've encountered an issue with the [product_name] function keys. In the example provided, pressing the F2 key causes the message "HELLO WORLD" to appear on both the [product_name] operator device and the [product_name] module with display. However, if the F2 key is pressed quickly, the message only shows on the [product_name] module, and the operator device does not respond. For the operator device to display the message, the F2 key needs to be pressed for a longer duration, approximately one second. I've tested this with different devices and saw the same behavior. Any suggestions are appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]

I agree that communication between the [product_name] module and the function keys of the operator device seems slower than when connecting a real input to a message text. To address this, you could try adding an off-delay (about 0.5 seconds) between F2 and the message display.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing delayed response times when using function keys on the [product_name] operator device, requiring a longer press (around one second) to trigger message displays. This issue occurs consistently across different hardware setups. The slower feedback affects the user experience, making interaction less immediate compared to using the [product_name] module with display.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] operator device to respond instantly to quick presses of function keys, similar to how the [product_name] module with display behaves.
